style: Agentes AI night-blue banner. Restrained typography, stable white supplied logo, fixed indigo CTA, static dark background. Headline alone changes with a short masked vertical slide and fade. Maintain readability when shown at half resolution.
shot_brief: Sobre azul noche, el logo Agentes AI y la invitación Solicitar demo quedan siempre visibles. La frase Responde a tus clientes se releva suavemente por Organiza tu seguimiento, manteniendo una línea secundaria que identifica WhatsApp, redes y CRM. El primer mensaje vuelve antes del final para repetir el video sin salto. Solo se anima el intercambio tipográfico; sin sonido, destellos o pulsaciones.

catalog_evidence.query: calm caption text fade slide reveal
catalog_evidence.description: A masked full-line beat replacement: line A holds center then exits up through an overflow-hidden mask as line B enters bottom-up on the same beat, with an optional accent underline drawing beneath one word of line B.

customize.reuse: Install line-swap and reuse its masked sibling-line markup and timeline mechanism. Adapt typography, positions, envelope and displacement; do not animate the supplied logo, CTA or background.
customize.loop: A fully visible at t=0. A→B from 3.6 to 4.0. B holds through 7.2. B→A from 7.2 to 7.6. A holds through 8.0. Restore exact x/y/opacity values for identical first and last appearance.
rules: explicit absolute opacity/transform states on a single paused timeline

scenes.motion: masked soft line swap during first 0.4s, then hold
reverse masked swap during first 0.4s, then exact initial-state hold

source_notes: Copy summarizes actual local index.html hero lead and CTA. No numerical performance claims, prices or invented results. Mobile is a dedicated layout rather than desktop crop.
